development_disclosure.finding: Repeated linear field lookup exposed a wide-schema hotspot.
development_disclosure.repair: A cached field-name index was added to propagated schemas.

development_disclosure.finding: The unopened 1024-node case exceeded the recursive graph traversal depth before measurement.
development_disclosure.repair: Graph validation and topological propagation were changed to iterative traversal.

scientific_claim_authorized: Across the frozen in-process control-plane grid, Validator completed every case with the expected ACCEPT or REWRITE status, a deterministic canonical digest, and zero uncaught exceptions. The largest measured cases contained 1,536 plan nodes, 3,072 output fields, 15,000 applicable policies, or 15,000 raw compatible obligations.
scientific_boundary: The benchmark isolates one dimension at a time using synthetic metadata fixtures.
It excludes DBMS execution, network I/O, policy retrieval, and unsupported IR forms.
The six measured points per dimension do not establish asymptotic complexity.
V1 and the pre-measurement V2 failure remain part of the disclosed development record.
